title: What would you do if your AI Game Blew Up!
author: NegativePoetry1561
selftext:
I was thinning about this a lot lately, and I honestly wouldn't know what I would do if my AI Game would blow up and becomes super successful! I made my first game free, even though the original code was actually code over a long period of time, after I finished I decided to make it a Browser game and I wasn't about to start coding from scratch so I AI'd it. As any sane person would do these days!

Now it's out there, Open Beta...and I honestly would be super happy and over the moon but also overwhelmed if the Game blew up and became a success.

What would you do?

comments.author: fungus_is_amungus
comments.body: Spend it all on hookers. Just as non Ai devs do, just look at dayz devs, hookers for days!

replies.author: NegativePoetry1561
replies.body: Lol, not my thing, I am very happy with my Wife. I'd rather spend it on the Game, and if anything is left over a nice trip with her 😄

replies.author: Silent_Glass
replies.body: Look at this man being wholesome and shit..

replies.author: NegativePoetry1561
replies.body: Well, I waited a very long time to find the perfect woman

comments.author: StoneCypher
comments.body: i would pay off my mortgage and `<voice type="text/craig">`i would be so happy`</voice>`

replies.author: NegativePoetry1561
replies.body: That's super Smart, but what if it is a Free Game that blows up and becomes a success? What would you do then, would you celebrate that so many people enjoy it or find a way to monetize it?

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
it depends a lot on the game.

is it some big deep game?  is it like free master of orion?  yeah, i might try to sell some cosmetics and reacts and shit.

is it line rider?  nah, i'd just add a link to my next game

i'd celebrate either way

comments.author: lorean_victor
comments.body: I think I’d be playing it more, and would be tuning it more with the extra feedback. that would probably also lead to more ideas on how to expand it or shake it up over time. but besides that, I would do what I was doing before it became successful. i’m happy with what I do in life, so it’s not like i’m waiting for a big break or something to change that.

comments.author: gfe_TheHouse
comments.body:
I'd probably replace a lot of the art with human art, first. If it got big enough I'd likely have to pay for more servers, but the scaling out is automatic already. If it gets really big I'll probably need to do more performance tweaks on how the users are assigned to servers. 

If it absolutely exploded to the point where I could justify quitting my job I probably would. And then I'd add more stuff to the game. 

I'm adding stuff anyway, though. 

When I first launched I was worried I'd get like 100 people and the server wouldn't handle it but it turns out that was never a concern. Hah.

replies.author: NegativePoetry1561
replies.body: Yeah replacing the Art would be my first thing too, Art and Audio!

comments.author: Heath_co
comments.body: I would turn on usage credits on my Claude account.

comments.author: je386
comments.body:
I would be happy and hopefully, players would use the map and level editor and make great levels and publish them as community levels, as intended.

I would not make any money (free and open source), but having people playing your game is kinda cool.

comments.author: No-Marionberry-772
comments.body: invest in financial security, whatever that means which depends on how much I earn

comments.author: Mazapan93
comments.body: I would use the money I got from it to hire game devs and artists to further improve the game, minimizing the use of AI overall. Also pay off debts.

replies.author: NegativePoetry1561
replies.body: Noble idea, but I would focus on Artists, even the big ones are using more and more AI.

comments.author: OneManGameStudio76
comments.body: If I ever release and it blows up, I'll hire programmers, and artists to remaster my game so that it can get a console release.

comments.author: Kindly-Sail6260
comments.body: If people like it then it doesn’t really matter what happens post virality. Just keep working on making fun games.

comments.author: PowerQuestStudios
comments.body:
If Power Quest ever becomes successful, I'd make a sequel. 

And I'd make sure a human artist gets paid.

FREE demo:

[https://powerqueststudios.itch.io/power-quest-demo](https://powerqueststudios.itch.io/power-quest-demo)

comments.author: LiteratureSelect4478
comments.body:
Nothing  id treat it as normal. Sure there is more eyes and comments but I wouldn't care id just keep making the game i want. 

Personally I don't do it for money.

comments.author: According-Pressure39
comments.body: Im developing for more than a Month now, and a lot of months to come! So Yeah I have Hopes to bring a high quality Product!

replies.author: According-Pressure39
replies.body: A Space Sandbox Simulation and Empire Management Game! Think of something Like EVE Online with Mount and Blade!

replies.author: NegativePoetry1561
replies.body:
Oh nice.

Here is what I made [https://horizon.forgottenpixel.com](https://horizon.forgottenpixel.com)

It's remake of a very old Mac game, but with a few new features. You play alone, but your actions will affect on all players.

replies.author: According-Pressure39
replies.body:
And to answer your initial question! 

I would Pay Away my Debt and depending on how much I would make, I would Buy a Home and create my own Gaming Brand!
